description: Manages conversation memories and user profiles in Alibaba Cloud Bailian (Model Studio) Memory Library via DashScope REST APIs. Covers memory extraction from conversations, direct content saving, semantic memory search, memory fragment maintenance, user profile queries and updates, plus memory project and profile schema administration. Use when the user requests memory library ("记忆库") operations such as "add memory", "search memory" or "user profile". Prerequisites: (1) Configure DashScope API Key (2) Activate Bailian Memory Library service. Do NOT use for Bailian RAG knowledge base retrieval or document search.
